description: This header file declares functions and structures related to converting object files between different hash algorithms in a version control system, likely Git. It provides function prototypes for converting object IDs and entire object files.

methods.name: repo_oid_to_algop
methods.description: Converts an object ID from a repository to a specified hash algorithm, storing the result in 'dest'.

methods.name: convert_object_file
methods.description: Converts an object file from one hash algorithm to another, returning 0 on success and -1 on failure.
